facts_found: Freeze is a temporary lock (unfreezable); close is permanent deactivation. If the customer confirms the card is lost or stolen, the bank recommends closing instead of freezing. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Freezing a debit card declines all new transactions and recurring payments, but already-authorized pending transactions may still process; the customer can unfreeze at any time via customer service or the mobile app. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]
Freezing does not block ATM use if the customer has the PIN; ATM access requires separately enabling 'ATM Block' in the mobile app. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Cards reported lost or stolen are closed immediately with no cooling-off period, and lost/stolen/fraud reasons bypass the 14-day minimum card age requirement. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]

Closing a debit card requires: verified customer, card ownership (user_id match), card status ACTIVE or PENDING, no pending/processing transactions, and no pending refunds (or written acknowledgment that refunds go to the linked checking account). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]

A closed debit card is permanently deactivated, cannot be reactivated, and recurring payments on it must be updated with new card information; refunds to a closed card are credited to the linked checking account. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]

Each debit card is linked to exactly one checking account, and a customer cannot have more than 1 active debit card per checking account, so the two lost cards must be closed and replaced separately, one per account. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_023]

Debit cards for an account are retrieved with get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823(account_id), returning card_id, status (ACTIVE/PENDING/FROZEN/CLOSED), issue_reason, date_issued, card_design and limits. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_028]

Replacement eligibility per account: verified customer, account_type 'checking', status OPEN, open at least 3 business days, at most 1 active debit card, minimum balance $25, customer at least 18 years old, no pending debit card order for the same account, and a valid US domestic address (international shipping unavailable). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_023]

Standard delivery is free and takes 7-10 business days; expedited is $15 and 3-5 business days; rush is $35 and 1-2 business days; fees may vary by account tier. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_023]

All replacement shipping, design and excess-replacement fees are automatically charged to the linked checking account at order time, and the order fails if the account has insufficient funds. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]

ELITE tier replacement policy: unlimited replacement cards, no waiting period after closure, complimentary shipping on STANDARD, EXPEDITED and RUSH (delivery_fee $0), and same-business-day priority processing if ordered before 2pm EST. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]

ENTRY tier replacement policy: maximum 2 replacement cards per rolling 12-month period, a 48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered, standard shipping only (no expedited) at delivery_fee $0, and a $25 excess replacement fee if the limit is exceeded. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]

Design fees: ENTRY and MID tier CLASSIC $0 / PREMIUM $10 / CUSTOM $25; PREMIUM tier CLASSIC $0 / PREMIUM $0 / CUSTOM $15; ELITE tier CLASSIC, PREMIUM and CUSTOM all $0. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]

Replacement history is counted from cards with issue_reason 'lost', 'stolen', 'fraud' or 'damaged' issued in the last 12 months; 'new_account', 'first_card', 'expired', 'upgrade' and 'bank_reissue' do not count toward the limit. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]
Bluest Account is classified as ELITE tier for personal checking accounts. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_005]
Light Green Account is classified as ENTRY tier for personal checking accounts. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_005]
Light Green Account is restricted to primary holders aged 13-24, which can conflict with the 18-year minimum for ordering a debit card. [doc_checking_accounts_light_green_account_002]

Replacement cards issued for lost/stolen/fraud must be activated with activate_debit_card_8292 (not 8291 or 8293); activation requires the physical card, PENDING status, an OPEN linked checking account, last 4 digits, expiration date (MM/YY), CVV, and setting a new 4-digit PIN that is not sequential or repeating. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_024]

After activating a lost/stolen replacement, the agent must remind the customer to review recent transactions for unauthorized charges and recommend changing the online banking password if fraud was suspected. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_024]

Wallet-theft cross-product protocol: after completing the debit card freeze/close procedure, the agent must check for Rho-Bank credit cards with get_credit_card_accounts_by_user and proactively offer a replacement credit card with a new number, noting the offer if declined. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_030]

Regulation E limits customer liability for unauthorized debit card use to a maximum of $50 if reported within 2 business days, $500 within 60 days, and potentially the full amount after 60 days. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_037]
Customers can track replacement card shipment status in the Rho-Bank mobile app; new cards are automatically activated upon first use with PIN entry. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_023]
A card reported lost cannot be reactivated even if later found; the customer must use the replacement card. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_037]

facts_found: Replacement credit cards are ordered with the discoverable tool order_replacement_credit_card_7291, which must first be enabled via unlock_discoverable_agent_tool and then invoked via call_discoverable_agent_tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

Required inputs for order_replacement_credit_card_7291: the customer's credit card account identifier (account_id/card_id from the account lookup), reason, shipping_address, shipping_speed, expedited_fee_acknowledgement (consent if a fee applies for the tier), and notes. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]
The replacement reason must be exactly one of: fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired, or other. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

The card does not have to be closed first: after the replacement order is submitted the old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

Ordering a replacement creates a new card with a different card number and CVV; the account number is unchanged so recurring payments linked to the account continue, but the customer should update saved card details with merchants. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_003]
Standard delivery is 7–10 business days and free for all cardholders; expedited delivery is 2–3 business days. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]

facts_found: Freezing a debit card declines new and recurring transactions but pending already-authorized transactions may still process, and freezing does not block ATM access unless 'ATM Block' is separately enabled. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

The replacement reason must be exactly one of: fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired, or other. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

The card does not have to be closed first: after the replacement order is submitted the old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

Ordering a replacement creates a new card with a different card number and CVV; the account number is unchanged so recurring payments linked to the account continue, but the customer should update saved card details with merchants. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_003]
Standard delivery is 7–10 business days and free for all cardholders; expedited delivery is 2–3 business days. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]
Expedited shipping fee for mid-tier cards — including Silver Rewards Card — is $10.00 (entry tier $15.00; premium tier and above $0.00/complimentary). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]

Expedited shipping is strongly recommended when the card was stolen or fraud is suspected; for a lost card the customer simply chooses standard or expedited. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]
